transcript: Speaker A: Bhaiya, meri solo photo mai poori saree dikhni chahiye. [Brother, in my solo photo, the whole saree should be visible.] Speaker B: Yes, ma'am. Do you have a specific pose in mind or should I suggest something? Speaker A: Bhaiya, photo chhodo. Aap apni English ka raaz batao. [Brother, forget the photo. Tell me the secret of your English.] Speaker B: Madam, maine toh English Seekho app se seekha hai. [Madam, I learned from the English Seekho app.] Speaker A: Maine bhi online classes lagayi thi, par main bore ho jaati hu. [I also took online classes, but I get bored.] Speaker B: English Seekho ke videos aapko bore nahi hone denge. Chhote-chhote aur damdaar video ka combination hai yaha. [English Seekho's videos won't let you get bored. It's a combination of short and powerful videos.] Speaker A: Aur practice? Usme toh mujhe bahut sharm aati hai. [And practice? I feel very shy about that.] Speaker B: Uski tension mat lo. App mein AI hai, woh aapko saari practice karwa degi. Aur galti hone par teacher ki tarah dategi nahi, balki dost ki tarah samjhayegi. [Don't worry about that. There is AI in the app, it will make you practice everything. And if you make a mistake, it won't scold you like a teacher, but explain like a friend.] Speaker A: Achha! Lekin yeh app mehanga toh nahi hai na? [Oh! But this app isn't expensive, right?] Speaker B: Bilkul bhi nahi. Maine khud 1 rupaye mein 3 din ka trial liya tha. [Not at all. I myself took a 3-day trial for 1 rupee.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

He introduces her to the English Seekho app, explaining its engaging short videos, friendly AI practice feature, and an affordable 3-day trial for just 1 rupee.
